tokens.name: Gossip
tokens.text: Search your bag for a token of your choice and add it to your hand.

tokens.name: Banter
tokens.text: Steal a token from your opponent's hand and place it in your bag.

tokens.name: Instruction
tokens.text: Swap two places in the initiative order by 1.

tokens.name: Misinformation
tokens.text: Stops draws for the round when drawn. Major action to turn into chatter.

tokens.name: Blackmail
tokens.text: When a noble declares their movement, force a Shift action and control it.

tokens.name: Rumor
tokens.text: When another noble takes an action, cancel it. Then, replace the rumor token with a gossip token.

tokens.name: Chatter
tokens.text: When returning this token to the bag, discard it instead.
